title: Species Recovery Tracker Update — May 13, 2026
summary: Mountain gorilla census released May 10 confirms 1,063+ individuals across Bwindi and Virunga — growing at 3.7% annually, up from 1,004 in 2018 and just 620 in 1989. Colorado gray wolves reached 32 individuals with record-high pup recruitment in the 2025-2026 annual report. A Washington Post/Foreign Policy analysis confirmed conservation has prevented hundreds of extinctions globally, with the Iberian lynx now at 2,401 (KPI updated) and California condor at 607+ (KPI updated). On the threat side, ongoing coverage of the Trump administration 'God Squad' ESA exemption documented continued legal battles to protect the critically endangered Rice's whale and sea turtles from expanded Gulf of Mexico oil drilling. Five new events added across April 24 – May 10, plus a new map point for North America's largest wildlife crossing in Colorado.
